segments.contextAfter: `configuration_web_url` (string): The URL that the clients load into a web view during setup. This site provides the appropriate UI to authenticate the user, and when satisfied, initiates the download of the MDM enrollment profile. To provide the MDM enrollment profile, the web view looks for a page with MIME type `application/x-apple-aspen-config`. While the user is allowed to navigate to any site or host during authentication, the MDM enrollment profile must originate from the same host as specified in this field.
